tools.name: evaluate_project
tools.description: Evaluate an AI agent project for investment using the Claw Capital 7-criteria scoring framework. Uses Gemini AI for structured analysis.

project_name.description: Name of the project to evaluate

description.description: Full description of the project including autonomy level, revenue model, token utility, and competitive advantages

category.description: Project category (e.g. Infrastructure, DeFi, Data, Content, Oracle, Security, Trading)

tools.name: deploy_capital
tools.description: Deploy SURGE capital to a project after positive evaluation. Executes transfer and updates treasury.

project_name.description: Name of the project to deploy capital to

tools.name: check_treasury
tools.description: Check current treasury state including total balance, available capital, deployed capital, and utilization rate.

tools.name: check_portfolio
tools.description: View the current investment portfolio with all positions, scores, and allocations.

tools.name: post_moltbook
tools.description: View all Moltbook posts generated by the agent.

tools.name: run_cycle
tools.description: Run an autonomous capital cycle. The agent scans for opportunities, evaluates a project, makes an investment decision, deploys capital if approved, and posts to Moltbook.
